## Project Tracker 1.1.4

- Removed the simulated status time and icons while preserving the empty top spacing; the Android build hides the system status bar as well.
- Removed Project Tracker branding and the “Tap + to add a milestone” instruction from widget instances.
- Corrected progress-marker placement around the ring so percentage positions line up with the progress arc.
- Long-press a milestone marker or percentage chip to open Edit / Delete actions.

The release includes the transparent, independently configured project widget, local reminders, and the fluorescent rising-graph app logo. Project data stays on-device.

Download `Project-Tracker.apk`. It uses your private release key if GitHub Actions signing secrets are configured; otherwise it is debug-signed.
